summary: This video previews upcoming 3rd Anniversary events shown on the test server. Key highlights include the Otherworld Tour 14-day check-in event which awards a free Legendary Hero Prime Chest, allowing players to select a legendary hero from a fixed pool. Other featured events include Starweave Echo (exchanging duplicate imprints for fragments), Starlight Delights (a 100% Dragon Crystal rebate up to 30,000 crystals), the Nightveil Standoff faction event, and the Coronation of Night hero skin voting event.
meta_changes: Starweave Echo event allows players to exchange duplicate hero imprints for Starweave Fragments up to 50 times (600 fragments total).
Otherworld Tour 14-day check-in awards a free Legendary Hero Prime Chest with a selectable hero pool.
Starlight Delights provides a 100% Dragon Crystal rebate up to 30,000 crystals along with milestone spending rewards.
tips: Log in daily for 14 days during the anniversary event to obtain the free Legendary Hero Prime Chest.
Exchange unwanted duplicate imprints during the Starweave Echo event to collect Starweave Fragments.
If planning to spend, utilize the Starlight Delights rebate period to gain double value on Dragon Crystal purchases.
